mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.`name`, b.`code`, sum(a.num) AS checkTotalNumber, '0' AS checkCompleteNumber, b.unit, b.brand, b.amount, b.stock_min, b.stock_max FROM consumable b INNER JOIN consumable_store_stock a ON a.consumable_id = b.id where a.store_id = #{param.storeId} GROUP BY b.id

SELECT b.id, b.`name`, b.`code`, sum(a.num) AS checkTotalNumber, sum(a.check_num) AS checkCompleteNumber, b.unit, b.brand, b.amount, b.stock_min, b.stock_max FROM consumable_check_detail a INNER JOIN consumable b ON a.consumable_id = b.id where check_id = #{param.checkId}
and a.status=#{param.status}
select b.id, b.name, b.model, b.unit, a.num from consumable_check_detail a inner join consumable b on a.consumable_id = b.id where a.check_id = #{planId}

select sum(b.num) as value from consumable_add_record a inner join consumable_stock_detail b on a.id=b.stock_id where consumable_id = #{consumableId} and a.add_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and a.status ='PASS'

select sum(b.num) as value from consumable_reduce_record a inner join consumable_stock_detail b on a.id=b.stock_id where consumable_id = #{consumableId} and a.reduce_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and a.status ='PASS'
